weywot.title: Limits of Standard Tidal Models at Quaoar: Matching Weywot’s Orbit, Missing the Spin
weywot.publication: Record says accepted for publication in PASP; final publisher record/date not audited.
abstractAssessment: CPL and Andrade creep-tide orbit-averaged models over 4.5 Gyr test system evolution; not new measured satellite mass or spin.
Model matches requiring 5–10 times nominal moon mass and tuned initial eccentricity are not adopted as measurements.
Quaoar 17.7-hour spin and modelled partial differentiation/warm ice refer to the PRIMARY, not Weywot chemistry or local temperature.
External torque, early satellite loss and impact alternatives are hypotheses, not observed history.

vanth.title: Masses and densities of dwarf planet satellites measured with ALMA
abstractAssessment: ALMA barycentric astrometry over an orbit yields reported Vanth/Orcus mass ratio 0.16 ± 0.02; abstract-level inventory, no catalogue update.
Intact impactor and likely double synchronous evolution are interpretations; not a measured moon spin or directly observed origin.
Dysnomia/Eris results in the same paper must not be assigned to Vanth/Orcus.
Astrometric source separation does not establish resolved geography, visible colour or local composition.
open: Body-specific full-paper Vanth methods/tables/thermal and spin audit; earlier retained-paper audit targeted Dysnomia
